lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information and compiled by the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team. The dataset contains approximately 473.5 thousand mapped buildings with polygon geometries, representing an estimated 6% of total buildings in Iraq based on AI-assisted mapping validation. Data quality varies with an average age of 4 years and 2% of features updated within the last 6 months.
